entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. This better be quick. I am not in the mood for games.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return a jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size. I expect a full refund, and if I hear the word 'no,' I'm lighting up your social media. This is ridiculous.

I can certainly understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to help you with this. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

It's not a 'preference,' it's defective sizing! It's way too tight. I can barely get it on. I need to exchange this for a size that a normal human can actually wear. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
There's no need for that, I can absolutely handle this for you. Thank you for clarifying that it's a sizing issue. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered 56 days ago. You are correct, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for this item. I can definitely process this for you right now.
Wait, really? Just like that? You're not going to fight me on it?

Not at all. Since it's within the policy, it's a straightforward process. Would you like me to set up an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method?
Oh. Uh, well... I'll do the exchange. The jersey itself is fine, it was just the wrong size that was so infuriating. I thought this was going to be a whole thing.

I understand. I've just processed the exchange for you. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file now. As soon as you ship the original jersey back, we'll send out the new size to you. The whole process should be very smooth.
Okay. Well, good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
